newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Zebra Tech downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Zebra Tech downgraded.

text.p: Robert W. Baird & Co analyst Kim Stulo said Tuesday she downgraded the stock of Zebra Technologies Corp after certain senior executive officers registered to sell more than two million of the company's shares.
Stulo lowered the rating to moderate outperform from a strong buy because, she said, she is "uncomfortable given the large block of insider selling."
Stulo added that she hopes to speak with the officers.
Company officials were not immediately available.
Shares of Zebra, which makes bar code printers and supplies, were trading off 3-1/4 to 27-1/2.
